heading: “Local law”.
text: A “local law” is a law applicable only to a particular part of [7][[8]***[9][India]].
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)

amendment_history.footnote_text: Subs. by the A.O. 1948, for “British India”.
The words “the territories comprised in” omitted by Act 48 of 1952, s. 3 and the Second Sch.
Subs. by Act 3 of 1951, s. 3 and the Sch., for “the States” which had been subs. by the A.O. 1950, for “the Provinces”.
